newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta share index falls 1.85 pct at close.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta share index falls 1.85 pct at close.

text.p: Heavy selling in banking stocks, led by blue chip Bank Negara Indonesia, dragged down the index to close 1.85 percent lower on Thursday, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 12.62 points to 669.99 points after touching 667.06 points earlier. Total turnover was 409.8 billion rupiah on a volume of 208.4 million shares.
Losers led gainers by 108 to 24, with 55 counters unchanged.
Analysts and brokers said a sustained sell-off in banking shares prompted investors to sell other counters.

News that the central bank, Bank Indonesia, had limited the credit expansion of banks to 18 percent or a maximum of 62.8 trillion rupiah in 1997 triggered heavy selling in banking stocks, brokers said.
"There is a perception in the market that it will affect bank earnings in 1997," an analyst with a European securities firm said.
But he said so far he had not heard that any of the large banks planned to revise their 1997 earnings forecasts.
"I believe the market has over-reacted to the news," another analyst with a foreign brokerage said.
